source.prior_run_scope: Full integrated source, address, owner and browser run before this touch counterexample.

counterexample: On the pre-touch source Chromium delivered two touch pointer/click pairs without any dblclick, leaving the Philosophy field at w.
claim: The same shared return follows a pair of nearby primary empty touch contacts. The owner-supplied actual hit law remains authoritative. A lone contact is inert; pointer movement, cancellation, other pointers, keyboard, wheel and blur clear a pending pair.

evidence.native: Exact-source navigation-physiology, locus-shader and Papers owner suites passed; touch tests cover timing, distance, hit, drag, cancellation/other input and synthetic duplicate dblclick.
evidence.browser_scope: Actual browser input, pointer dispatch, mounted Philosophy and Papers canvases on a 390×844 emulated touch device. CDP event timestamps represent consecutive touches even when software rendering delays the automation transport. WebGL2 is Chromium SwiftShader.
evidence.limits: Neither browser emulation nor software rendering establishes physical-device timings or performance.
